SELECT GCM.MST_CD, GCM.MST_NM, GCS.SEQ, GCS.SUB_CD, GCS.SUB_NM, GCS.USE_YN, GCS.SORT_ORDER,
-- 🔥 날짜 컬럼은 문자열로 변환 TO_CHAR(GCS.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REG_DT, TO_CHAR(GCS.MOD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS MOD_DT
FROM GROUP_CODE_MST GCM LEFT OUTER JOIN GROUP_CODE_SUB GCS ON GCM.MST_CD = GCS.MST_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND GCM.MST_CD = #{_parameter} AND GCS.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY GCS.SORT_ORDER
